title: Treasury Marketable Borrowing Estimates (Q2 2027 / Q3 2027), 15:00 ET
source: EST: derived from the published Monday/Wednesday refunding rule this calendar already carries on treasury-borrowing-estimates-2026-11-02 (confirmed) and treasury-refunding-2026-11-04 — Treasury holds its quarterly refunding on the FIRST WEDNESDAY of February, May, August and November, with the marketable-borrowing estimates at 15:00 ET on the Monday of that week. home.treasury.gov/policy-issues/financing-the-government/quarterly-refunding/most-recent-quarterly-refunding-documents was re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (plain curl, HTTP 200, 73,520 bytes) and states the pairing in its own words for the current cycle: '(The next release is scheduled for November 2, 2026)' under the Financing Estimates slot and '(The next release is scheduled for November 4 , 2026)' under the refunding slot. Recomputed mechanically: the first Wednesday of May 2027 is 2027-05-05, so the estimates Monday is 2027-05-03. Filed estimate on two counts — Treasury has published no 2027 refunding calendar this far out, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of tic-annual-survey-final-2027-04-30, 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED as the measured confound in the tic-annual-survey-final-2027-04-30 tape leg, and that is this proposal's whole point rather than a footnote to it. Because 2027-04-30 falls on a FRIDAY, the session immediately after the TIC annual survey's final report is this release — so no move in the 10-year on 2027-05-03 can be attributed to the survey. That is not a one-off: cross-referencing every final report of the modern Feb/Apr regime (2008-2026) against the refunding cycle puts 11 of 19 on or one session from a scheduled refunding-cycle release (6 where the next session is the estimates Monday, 3 where it is the refunding Wednesday, 2 where the release day itself is the estimates Monday). The sibling treasury-borrowing-estimates-2026-11-02 already measured this release as NIL on its own tape (8 clean releases since 2023: TLT 4/8 up at +0.056%, permutation p=0.860; SPY p=0.704; ^TNX p=0.989) and filed it LOW on that basis — READ IT, DO NOT TRADE IT. Impact LOW here for the same reason. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
